elements.texte:
[cheerful] The date function calculates a date from another one.

We write the date, then the duration to add, in quotes: plus 7 days.

Adding 7 days to the order of July 2 gives July 9: the scheduled date for the follow-up message.

In the query, the follow underscore up column gives the date of each message.

Careful: order underscore date plus 7 gives 2033, not a date.

With the plus sign, the date is read as the number 2026: 2026 plus 7 equals 2033.

elements.texte:
[cheerful] Date follows the calendar: July 28 plus 7 days gives August 4.

July has 31 days: after July 31, the date moves to August 1st.

Without a calendar, 28 plus 7 would give July 35, a date that doesn’t exist.

The duration can also count in months or years: plus 1 month, plus 1 year.

elements.texte:
[cheerful] String format time changes how a date is displayed.

The percent d, slash, percent m, slash, percent capital Y format shows the date 2026, dash, 07, dash, 02 as 02, slash, 07, slash, 2026.

Each format gets part of the date. Here, percent d returns 02, the day of the month.
